entry.label: Requisite variety
entry.description: The regulatory requirement and limit expressed by Ashby: reducing outcome variety depends on the regulator having usable discriminations and responses relative to disturbances and constraints.
entry.canonical_definition: The variety needed in a regulator, given disturbances, transformations and acceptable outcomes, to achieve the intended reduction in outcome variety. It is a limit on regulation, not a general instruction to maximise complication.

profile.title: Requisite variety
profile.canonical_definition: The variety needed in a regulator, given disturbances, transformations and acceptable outcomes, to achieve the intended reduction in outcome variety. It is a limit on regulation, not a general instruction to maximise complication.
profile.summary: Ashby's law sets a limit on regulation. Disturbance variety can only be reduced to the extent that the regulator has relevant, selectable and effective response variety within the transformation being regulated. Ashby's bound depends on the disturbance–response table. Section 11/9 also allows the transformation itself to remove variety.
profile.why_it_matters: The slogan is often used to justify more choice, more management or decentralisation in the abstract. The law asks a harder question: which responses can distinguish and counter which disturbances, under what communication and resource constraints? Count responses that can actually be selected and act, rather than nominal options.
key_distinctions: attenuation and amplification vs maximal complication
law of requisite variety vs good regulator theorem
necessary regulatory capacity vs a universal organisational prescription
raw disturbance variety versus variety reaching the regulated outcome
historical_lineage: Conant and Ashby 1970: good regulator theorem
Beer: application in management cybernetics and VSM
practice_connections: map where variety is generated, attenuated and amplified
increase response repertoire only where it can affect outcomes
reduce avoidable disturbance rather than merely adding control
protect local autonomy where it carries relevant knowledge
Specify disturbances, responses, and acceptable outcomes before applying the inequality.
common_misreadings: the controller must simply be more complicated
the theorem proves decentralisation in every case
the good regulator theorem is the same theorem
The regulator must reproduce every environmental detail.
open_checks: exact provenance of absorb variety wording
Test any organisational mapping against the formal assumptions.
